description: Demonstrates the resumable-run convention from Discussion #10: a ResultSet that only covers part of its suite's test cases (e.g. an interrupted run) is marked with metadata.openeval.partial: true (needs no schema change -- ResultSet.metadata already allows arbitrary keys), and each result carries its own completed_at timestamp (a schema addition -- see spec/schemas/resultset.json) so two partial ResultSets for the same run_id can be merged deterministically: for any test_case_id present in both, the result with the later completed_at wins. A merge tool encountering a result with no completed_at at all (an older or non-conforming producer) should refuse to guess an ordering and require the caller to specify precedence explicitly, rather than silently picking a default that could produce a confidently-wrong merged ResultSet.
